text:
samir: Proposal sketch: a tenant-directed scaling model where tenants submit a tiny "pacing" contract (burst credits + target sustained rps) and the cluster operator enforces admission, prewarm, and graceful degradation. RFC: https://r.rw/tenant-directed-scaling  

elaine: Love the idea. We need to be explicit about invariants: global headroom can't be depleted by simultaneous bursts. What's the protective mechanism?

samir: Protective mech = global credit reservoir + per-tenant soft ledgers. Operator debits from ledger on admit. If ledger empty -> try fallback variant -> if that fails -> deny. Reservoir used for cross-tenant spillonly.

jon: Important: the control-plane should store only intents and quotas. Enforcement decisions (who wins prewarm) should be fully in operator runtime so control-plane stays lightweight.

samir: Agreed. Operator modules: admit-check, prewarm-coordinator, fallback-router, arbitration-plug.

priya: How do we arbitrate when N tenants ask for prewarm together? We need a deterministic cheap algo. Suggest: score = priority*weight + recent-usage-decay. Use that to allocate prewarm slots.

elaine: Make arbitration policy hotpluggable config. Also include a fairness knob so small tenants don't starve.

jon: Race I saw in earlier tests: operator prewarms a node, autoscaler sees low cpu and scales down immediately. Fix: when operator prewarms mark node with soft-reservation lease TTL that autoscaler respects. TTL renewed while prewarm in progress.

samir: TTL idea is good. TTL should be short (~60s) and configurable. If operator crashes lease expires and autoscaler reclaims.

priya: Observability items: per-tenant: credits_remaining, admits/sec, fallback_count, prewarm_latency. Cluster: reservoir_level, spill_events, arbitration_decisions. Expose in console.

orch-bot: CI: tenant-directed-operator branch build started (ci#5092) :gear:

elaine: Also we need audit logs whenever fallback or deny happens: tenant, reason, cluster_capacity_at_time, chosen_variant. Makes postmortems easier.

jon: Tests: mix of scenarios. Examples: single-tenant spike, correlated spikes across 50 tenants, operator restart mid-spike, autoscaler+operator interplay. Add loadgen harness to replay real traffic traces.

priya: Recovery mode: define emergency_budget that only critical tenants (tagged) can consume when cluster emergencies happen. Operator must check tenant metadata before honoring prewarm.

samir: Config proto example (pseudo):
```
TenantPolicy {
  tenant_id: string
  pacing {
    burst_credits: 150
    sustained_rps: 4
  }
  prewarm {
    min_seconds: 30
    max_instances: 3
  }
  fallback_variant: "cpu-small-quant"
  priority: 10
  critical: false
}
GlobalPolicy {
  reservoir_capacity: 2000
  emergency_budget: 500
  arbitration_policy: "weighted_revenue"
}
```

elaine: Rollout plan: feature-flagged operator -> internal tenants (5) -> expanded beta (50) -> GA. Add dashboards and SLOs before beta.

jon: Minor: ensure metrics include "why" for SLO breaches (admit_failed/reservoir_empty/fallback_used). That helps automation and alerts.

samir: I'll open PR with operator skeleton + proto + metrics + basic arbitration. Will include simulation harness.

priya: Add chaos tests for node flapping and lease expiration races. We should also fuzz pacing params to detect degenerate configs.

samir: PR: https://git.rw/r/redwood/infra/pulls/1492  (wip)

elaine: Nice. Let's review tomorrow 3pm. Thanks. :thumbsup:
